summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various specifications and enhancements, including the addition of relative paths to the v4 spec and addressing ambiguities in the Avro schema for partition transforms. Additionally, integration efforts with Spark continue, emphasizing variant support and API upgrades.
highlights: Discussion on adding relative paths to v4 spec
Ongoing integration efforts with Spark, including DSv2 API upgrades
Specification ambiguity regarding Avro schema for 'day' partition transforms
Proposal to integrate OpenTelemetry MetricsReporter into iceberg-core
